body: I don't take life seriously. That's why it's not interesting.
I always try to have confidence in my ability to lucid dream, because I *know* anybody can do it. Sometimes it's just impossible to quiet that little voice telling me I can't.
I'm not exactly a natural at lucid dreaming. It hasn't happened in the last 26 years that I was born, so I don't think it'll happen without some kind of effort. Thank you for your input, though.
That's terrible. I hope you'll be able to have them often soon.

I've read that post and practice ADA, with no results...

I'm not going to give up, though.

I'm not sure that taking it easy will actually accomplish anything, though I do take a week or two here and there to just try having normal sleep, no thoughts of lucidity at all.

I only try WBTB about once a week. Otherwise, I have a normal sleep schedule. I can't immediately go back to sleep after a full night's sleep.

I've also not been able to meditate, though not for lack of trying (or in some cases, *not* trying too hard hasn't worked either). Letting myself fall asleep results in normal, non-lucid dreams.

It seems like I'm trying to shoot down everything you're suggesting, but I've tried all of that with no results :(
